issue.detail: Spec says capture when input changes 1->0; contract uses prev_in & ~in (any falling bit) and sets only those bits. Alternative semantics: capture sets all 32 output bits to 1 if any bit falls (sticky global flag). Distinguishing sequence: row1 reset=0,in=0x00000001; row2 reset=0,in=0x00000000. Per-bit semantics yields out=0x00000001; global-any semantics yields out=0xFFFFFFFF.
issue.spec_evidence: For each bit in a 32-bit vector, capture when the input signal changes from 1 in one clock cycle to 0 the next.
issue.alternative: Any falling bit sets all 32 output bits to 1 (global sticky flag).

issue.detail: Initial value of prev_in / out_reg at time 0 is unspecified. Alternative: prev_in initialized to 0 vs all ones vs unknown. Distinguishing sequence: first row reset=0,in=0. If prev_in=0, no capture, out=0; if prev_in=all ones, capture all bits, out=0xFFFFFFFF (next cycle).
issue.alternative: prev_in initialized to all ones at time 0, causing a capture on first row if in=0.
